description:
## Problem
docs/internal/results-vendor-publication-terms.md (PR #4272, 2026-11-17) found that the vendor-terms table in the locality ADR (benchbox-site docs/development/adr/adr-client-link-locality-disclosure.md) rests on documents nobody has read:
- ClickHouse Cloud addendum (page shows 2026-04-10; a v20260917 PDF exists)
- Databricks Free Edition Terms
- Starburst Enterprise EULA and Galaxy Early Access Agreement
- CedarDB Enterprise and Trial terms, and Community Exhibits 1-2
It also found that the AWS Service Terms attribution (2.3/2.5) and two Google terms dates differ from the 2026-10-22 table. evaluate_vendor_conditions (benchbox/validation/bundle.py) and the site publishing checklist enforce only what the table says, so an unread condition is unenforced.

## Decision gate
- Agent: read each document from the vendor's live site, quote every clause about benchmarking, publishing results, free/trial tiers or pre-release features, with URL and retrieval date, and correct the three mismatches.
- Owner: for each new condition found, choose how it is met (checklist step, bundle field, or validator refusal), the same choice made on vendor-benchmark-publication-conditions-20261022. A document with no such clause needs no decision.

## Guardrails
- Quote the vendor's own text; no paraphrase without the quote, no secondary sources (resellers, government copies) except as a pointer to the live page.
- No legal conclusions beyond what the text says; ambiguous clauses go to the owner.
- No code change before the owner decision for that condition.
- No live-cloud accounts are created to reach gated terms; a document behind a login is recorded as unreachable.
